categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the medical and healthcare information technology sector, focusing on software sales, system integration, and technical services. Its main product lines include hospital information systems (HI-HIS), electronic medical records (EMR), medical imaging systems (PACS), smart healthcare solutions, public health information platforms, internet healthcare applications, medical IoT products, and medical insurance application systems. The company serves hospitals, public health institutions, and healthcare management departments across various regions in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IT technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and microservices architecture. It follows a CMMI5 software maturity development process and emphasizes modular, intelligent, and cloud-native product architectures. The company also integrates AI large models and medical domain knowledge bases to enhance clinical decision support and healthcare service automation. Its production includes software development, onsite configuration, technical services, and system integration based on customer contracts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized hospitals, county-level health management institutions, public health agencies, and medical insurance bureaus. The company’s products and services cater to clinical, administrative, public health, and insurance sectors within the healthcare industry. Major markets are domestic Chinese healthcare institutions undergoing digital transformation and modernization, including tertiary hospitals and grassroots medical facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue contributions from East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Northwest China regions. It serves over 7,000 healthcare institutions nationwide and has projects in more than 370 counties. The company’s strategic projects and cloud platform deployments cover multiple provinces and cities, including Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the healthcare IT supply chain. It develops and delivers software products, system integration, and technical services directly to healthcare providers and government health agencies. It also collaborates with hardware suppliers and ecosystem partners but focuses on software and service provision rather than upstream manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing the 'HuiKang Cloud' strategy to promote cloudification and intelligent healthcare solutions, deepening AI integration in medical applications, and expanding digital health ecosystems. The company emphasizes R&D in AI large models, medical data governance, smart hospital systems, and interoperability standards. It pursues innovation through partnerships with universities and research institutes, focusing on AI-driven clinical decision support, healthcare IoT, and medical insurance digitalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software product sales, technical services (including software customization and maintenance), and system integration contracts. The company also earns income from cloud platform operations, internet healthcare services, and medical insurance application solutions. Its sales model is predominantly direct sales to healthcare institutions and government agencies, with revenue recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the medical and healthcare information technology industry in China. It holds a strong market share with over 7,000 institutional clients and is recognized as a top-tier healthcare IT solution provider. It competes with other domestic and international healthcare IT firms, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, AI capabilities, and strategic partnerships, including collaboration with Philips China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 1.42 billion RMB, representing an 11.96% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 173.5 million RMB. Despite revenue contraction due to market and project delays, the company maintains substantial asset base (~5.67 billion RMB) and equity (~4.42 billion RMB). R&D investment remains robust at over 23% of revenue, supporting long-term growth. The company is undergoing a strategic transition with ongoing product upgrades and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated, cloud-native, and AI-enabled healthcare IT solutions that support comprehensive digital transformation of medical institutions. Its products offer seamless interoperability, intelligent clinical decision support, and efficient hospital management, tailored to meet high-level accreditation standards. The company’s unique value lies in its deep healthcare domain expertise, extensive client base, advanced AI applications, and strategic collaborations, enabling it to deliver innovative, scalable, and secure healthcare information ecosystems.
